entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit customer support, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. I think. I'm not really sure how it works.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you tell me which product you're calling about?
It's the... um... the cycling shoes I bought. They're just not working for me. I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels.
I'm sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe, or more of a preference and fit issue?
I don't think they're broken. They just... they hurt. I tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but the fit is just wrong. The website was a bit confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I just need to verify a few details to check your return eligibility. When did you receive the cycling shoes?
Umm, let me see... It was a while ago. Maybe at the end of October? A little over a month ago, I think.
Okay, thank you for that. Let me just pull up your order. One moment.
Alright, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 38 days ago. Let me just check our current policy for you.

Okay, thank you for your patience. The good news is that our standard return policy covers items for 90 days from the delivery date. Since you're at day 38, you are well within the window to send them back for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's a relief! I was so worried it was too late. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, pack the shoes back in their original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, we'll process your refund. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you, David.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
